title: Karmelo Anthony murder verdict: Why we must reject racial proxies
text:
By Chantal Monique Duson, Op-ed contributor Thursday, June 11, 2026Dominique Alexander (right) walks with Karmelo Anthony, who was indicted in the April 2, 2025 stabbing death of 17-year-old Austin Metcalf during a high school track meet in Frisco, Texas. | YouTube/WFAA
A 17-year-old is dead. A 19-year-old has been convicted of murder. One white, one black — two families mourn.
Read Full Article: https://www.christianpost.com/voices/karmelo-anthony-murder-verdict-why-we-must-reject-racial-proxies.html
